name: workerd DBG --version
description: Checks whether the prod host can load and execute workerd-dbg.exe at all. Exit 0xc0000135 means missing DLL/runtime before main().
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $bin=Split-Path '${WorkerdPath}'; $w=Join-Path $bin 'workerd-dbg.exe'; Write-Output "workerd: $w"; if (-not (Test-Path $w)) { Write-Error "debug workerd not found: $w"; exit 2 }; & $w --version 2>&1 | Out-String; Write-Output "native exit=$LASTEXITCODE"; exit $LASTEXITCODE
